sdtest.title: SD card test
sdtest.quick_desc: Writes and reads back 256 MB to measure the speed.
sdtest.full_desc: Fills the free space and reads it all back: finds fake or failing cards. It can take hours.
sdtest.bad_blocks: %lld blocks differ from what was written
sdtest.full_warn: Keep the charger connected. The test files delete themselves at the end.
sdtest.error: Write or read error: the card may be failing.
sdtest.charge: Connect the charger for the full test
sdtest.slow: Slow card: disc games may load slowly.
sdtest.bad: Damaged data: the card is fake or failing, copy your files elsewhere.
sdtest.full_confirm: The full test writes over all the free space of the card that holds the system and your files. A healthy card loses nothing, but a fake or failing card can also damage the files already on it: back up your saves first. To check a new card, test it while it is empty.
sdtest.no_space: Not enough free space for the test
sdtest.read_errors: Read errors: the card may be failing.
sdtest.cached: Read from memory: the read speed is not the card's.
